system.description:
Used mainly by the starships of the Dominion, Phased polaron weapons are especially effective at overwhelming deflector shields.

Banks are a collection of emitters, designed to fire in unison. They produce a focused beam of energy that can inflict considerable damage. Banks have a Range category of Medium, and increase the weapon’s damage by +1 Challenge Die.

Piercing 2: The attack ignores 2 points of the target’s total Resistance for each Effect rolled.
